reviews.comment: I love Professor Rice, he's on the older side of the age spectrum and does not use canvas but I did not really mind. The writing assignments were not hard and I think it's more of a completion grade. The exams were difficult but nothing that will make you fail if you do well on the assignments. I took him 2 semesters in a row and liked it.

This class was meh, I didn't enjoy it mainly because we were tested over things that didn't seem relevant to applying the material to the real world. FYI, for Fall 2021 15% of people got A's, 70% B's, 15% C's. Everyone seemed to get full credit on his 5 written assignments but tests were kinda a wash with low B's mainly. Try something else first.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Rice spent the entire first half of the course on chapters 1 and 2 of the textbook. His grading criteria and exams were very very specific. If you're looking for an easy B, this is the class. If you want an A or to actually learn, I would pass.

I really enjoyed professor rice's class. It is a class on diversity so controversial things will be said sometimes but I personally enjoy that. There were around 5 question and answer hwk assignments which weren't difficult but you must format it exactly as he directs down to the staple in the corner. Only two exams that weren't difficult.

Professor Rice is a solid choice for POLS 320. I took his summer class and it was one of the most interesting classes I have taken. He has very clear grading criteria that you need to follow if you want to make a decent grade in his class. There are 4 readings with questions, research paper, and a test. You can make this class easy or hard!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: 5 handout assignments, 1 interview assignment, and 2 tests. Dr. Rice is very clear on the formatting that needs to be done on the assignments, do it and you'll receive a good grade. Hands out reviews for both exams, do them and you should do good on the exams. Overall enjoyed the class, and would take him again

Dr. Rice is a great professor. He gave us 5 writing assignments that were pretty straightforward, 2 exams, and one out if class interview. His expectations are quite clear, just do the work and pay attention to formatting. He does make some jokes that can make you feel singled out, so be tough, he does not really mean it.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Rice is a solid choice for POLS306. 2 m/c exams, 5 short assignments, and an interview assignment makeup the grades for this class. Gives review sheets before midterm and final, which makes it an easy B. As long as you do the reviews, and turn in your assignments (following his instructions to the letter), you'll be fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I took Dr. Rice for a summer session and I would take him again, he is clear how he wants his short assignment turned in. He made use do a 10-12 page paper that was useless to be honest, start on it early. He is funny and talks a lot about race and gender. Some people felt singled out, but he is just being him. Need some kind of tough skin.

DONT TAKE RICE. This class is an easy B if you're into that; however, if you are shooting for an A, STAND CLEAR. Rice is very unclear of how he wants the assignments completed, his tests are poorly written, and he is about the laziest prof you will ever meet. He is not helpful at all. I will never take Dr. Rice again.
